m: उद्-√ इ P. -एति, -एतुम् (and उद्-एतोस्, Maitr. i, 6, 10) to go up to, proceed or move up, proceed, RV.; AV.; VS.; to rise (as the sun or a star &c.), RV.; VS.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; VarBṛS. &c.; to come up (as a cloud), Mṛcch.; R.; to start up, rise up against, march off, AV. iii, 4, 1; MBh.; Kum.; to rise, raise one's self; to increase, be enhanced; to be conceited or proud, R.; Ragh.; Śiś. ii, 33; RPrāt. &c. ; to go out of; to come out or arise from, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Ragh. &c.; to escape, ChUp.; Śak. &c.: Pass. (impers. -ईयते) to be risen, Subh.
a: उदि — {c2c} P. 1 To rise (as a star, cloud &c.) (fig. also); come up; उदेति पूर्वं कुसुमं ततः फलं Ś. 7. 30; उदेति सविता ताम्रस्ताम्र एवास्तमोति च Subhāṣ.; Māl. 2. 10; Ki. 2. 36; Bk. 6. 110, 8. 35, 18. 20; to be seen, appear. --2 To be produced, come out or arise from, spring or proceed from; उदितदयः Dk. 13; पुण्यः कृशानोरुदियाय धूमः R. 7. 26; उदितश्रियं 1. 93 v. l.; Ś. 1. 26. --3 To go out, escape. --4 To start up; R. 17. 77. --5 To rise up against; Ku. 2. 57; य एनमुदीयाद्रथी Mb.

m: उद्-√ इङ्ग् Caus. -इङ्गयति, to impart a tremulous motion, vibrate, swing, RV. iv, 57, 4; ŚBr.; to cause (a sound) to vibrate, pronounce, RPrāt. xvii, 8.
उद्-इङ्गन n. swinging, oscillating, vibrating Comm. on KātyŚr.
उद्-इनक्ष् (anom. Desid. of √ नक्ष्) P. (p. -इनक्षत्) to wish or endeavour to obtain or reach; to strive after, pretend to, RV. x, 8, 9; 45, 7.
उदिताधान n. kindling fire after sunrise Comm. on ĀpŚr. v, 13, 2.
उदितानुदित mfn. ‘risen and not risen’, not quite risen, ĀpŚr. xv, 18, 13.
उदितानुवादिन् mfn. one who repeats what is said by others, AitBr. ii, 15.

m: 1. उद्-इत mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) risen, ascended
being above, high, tall, lofty, RV.; ChUp.; Mn. &c.
conceited, proud, boasting, MBh.
elevated risen
increased, grown, augmented, R.; Kir. &c.
born, produced, Bhartṛ.
apparent, visible, RV. viii, 103, 11
incurred, experienced.
2. उदित mfn. (p.p. of √ वद्, q.v.; for 1. See col. 1) said, spoken, AitBr.; Kathās.; Ragh.; Śiś. &c.
spoken to, addressed, BhP.; Śiś. ix, 61; Kathās.
communicated, proclaimed, declared, Mn.; Kathās.; BhP.; Rājat. &c.
(especially) proclaimed by law, taught, handed down
authoritative, right, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.; Yājñ. i, 154
indicated, signified, VarBṛS.
[a form उदित occurs, incorrectly spelt for उद्-दित, p. 188, col. 1.]
उदित See 2. उदित, p. 186.
a: उदित — p. p. 1 Risen, ascended; उदितभूयिष्ठः Māl. 1 mostly risen; Bv. 2. 85; नित्योदितः Bh. 3. 80 ever-existing. --2 High, tall, lofty. --3 Grown, augmented. --4 Born, produced. --5 Spoken, uttered (fr. वद्). --तं 1 A kind of perfume. --2 A kind of accent. --Comp. --उदित a. well grounded in the Śāstras. --होमिन् a. sacrificing after sunrise.

m: उद्-इत—होमिन् mfn. sacrificing after sunrise, AitBr.; ŚBr.

a: उदितिः — f. 1 Ascending, rising (of the sun). --2 Setting. --3 Speech.
